description: Most frequent ERROR log patterns of one Kubernetes Deployment over the last 30 minutes, per ReplicaSet, from the application logs shipped by OpenTelemetry. Use it to explain why a ReplicaSet fails. CATEGORIZE groups similar messages, so values inside the message (ids, currencies) can be folded into the pattern.

configuration.query:
FROM logs-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 30 minutes
    AND k8s.namespace.name == ?namespace AND k8s.deployment.name == ?deployment
    AND severity_text == "ERROR"
| STATS errors = COUNT(*) BY pattern = CATEGORIZE(body.text), k8s.replicaset.name
| SORT errors DESC
| LIMIT 10
